modules/analytics/SchedulesPage.tsx.reason: Free-text key: a saved explorer query has no store or list in the analytics service, so its id is typed. A dashboard target is a dashboard lookup.

modules/billing/NewShipmentProposalPage..reason: Slip lines and order lines belong to the packing slip and sales order chosen above; no lookup entity lists them on their own (the slip, order, customer and product are lookups).

modules/budgeting/CheckPage.tsx.reason: A budget document is any source document (requisition, PO, invoice); no single list spans them, so the field stays a typed id.

modules/budgeting/ReservationsPage.tsx.reason: A reservation names any source document and one of its lines; no single list spans them, so the fields stay typed ids.

modules/compliance/AuditRunPage.tsx.reason: Free-text key the caller assigns: compliance stores no audit policies (the whole rule is entered on this page and evaluated statelessly), and the id only keys the findings across runs. A policy master would be a new subsystem.

modules/compliance/ScreeningCheckPage.ts.reason: Structural: a DOCUMENT subject is a sales order, delivery, purchase order or payment owned by four services, and no single list spans them. A PARTY subject is a party lookup.

modules/integration/NewClientPage.tsx.reason: A sandbox tenant is another tenant; there is no tenant directory to look it up in.

modules/inventory/StatusChangesPage.tsx.reason: Inventory transactions carry no document number to search by, so there is nothing readable to pick from.

modules/lean/FlowPages.tsx.reason: Warehouse locations are listed per warehouse, and a flow activity names no warehouse to scope a location lookup to; the output location stays a typed id (the value stream is an operating unit lookup).

modules/pricing/NewPromotionPage.tsx.reason: Free-text key: the promotion's product is a key the pricing service keeps as text (it does not validate it as a product record), so a product lookup would store a different value.

modules/productcost/AdHocEstimatePage.ts.reason: Free-text key: the estimated object is a quote, internal order or project task reference (such as Q-1001) that the costing service stores as text and does not look up.

modules/purchasing/PurchaseOrderPages.ts.reason: An agreement line is picked from the trade agreement's lines; no lookup entity lists them on their own.

modules/purchasing/ServicePages.tsx.reason: An agreement line is picked from the contract's lines; no lookup entity lists them on their own.

modules/quality/CertificatesPanel.tsx.reason: Structural: inspection outcomes are rows of one quality order with no master record or number of their own; there is nothing to list them from outside the order.

modules/quality/ResultsEntry.tsx.reason: Structural: inspection outcomes are rows of one quality order with no master record or number of their own; there is nothing to list them from outside the order.

modules/transport/BuildLoadsPage.tsx.reason: Structural: a load is built from sales, transfer and inbound shipments, which fulfillment, inventory and receiving own; no single list spans the three, so the field stays a typed id.

modules/transport/NewCarrierInvoicePage..reason: Freight bills read by load and carrier, with no number of their own; the carrier is a vendor lookup.

modules/transport/NewRateCardPage.tsx.reason: Carrier services are carrier/party master data the transport service does not list yet; the carrier is a vendor lookup.

modules/transport/RateShopPage.tsx.reason: Structural: the shipment to rate is a sales, transfer or inbound shipment owned by fulfillment, inventory or receiving; no single list spans the three, so the field stays a typed id.
